A stay in our Colonial Wagon offers a truly unique and comfortable escape. Nestled in a tranquil countryside setting, this one-of-a-kind accommodation boasts quality craftsmanship and fine furnishings. Inside, you'll find a spacious super-king bed, well-equipped kitchenette, and a cozy lounge area. For additional guests, we offer a nearby sleepout building with two bunk beds, providing combined accommodation for up to four guests. Outside, enjoy panoramic views of Mt. Fyffe and the charm of an outdoor bath. Exclusive access to our private collection of farm animals and the option for Llama Trekking add to the experience, making it a memorable getaway unlike any other.

FAQs, blogs, Newsletters
Frequently Asked Questions
Are you open all year?
YES, our rentals are available all year, with the exception of the Tipi, which is not available through winter.
Is the Yurt COLD in winter?
Absolutely not, the Mongolian Yurt is double-skinned, and fully insulated with thick camel hair fiber wall and ceiling batts; has an insulated wooden floor; and includes internal electric heating.
Do I need to book the FREE guided animal feeding tours?
NO, you do not need to book.
We offer two FREE guided animal feeding tours every day @ 8:15am and 3:15pm (autumn, winter), or 5pm (summertime, spring). You simply turn-up at the appointed time and enjoy meeting and helping feed our 80+ animals.
How near to Kaikoura is Wacky Stays?
We are 4km from Kaikoura centre, which takes about six minutes to drive. We are located within the rural zone, surrounded by farmland.
Tell me more about your Llama Trekking?
Llama Trekking is an extremely popular off-site, hands-on, exotic animal tour available every day of the year (except Christmas day). Currently, we have sixteen trained male trekking llama. We offer small groups, dedicated tour guide, exclusive, interactive tours of up to eight guests, in either one-hour or half-day trek lengths. Tours include: Llama stories, Kaikoura information & earthquake tales, and lots of learning how to interact with llama, which is a hugely rewarding challenge!
More details, including: Pricing, photos and videos are available via our dedicated website: www.llamatrekking.co.nz
What are the kitchen and bathroom configurations?
Each property has a slightly different configuration depending on its: Size, design, construction and location, which is described within the property description pages, and their photos and videos.
Most properties have their own self-catering kitchen, barbeque facility, and private bathroom.
Can we bring our pet(s)?
YES, absolutely (no charge), but we do ask a few housekeeping things so everyone is happy, eg: please pickup any excrement, not on the furniture, clean up excessive hairs, not in our animal areas, please help by introducing your dog(s) to ours so there are not territorial surprises! (Both our dogs are neutered).
Please let us know you will be bringing pets in advance, so we can email a more detailed list of comments and concerns, thanks!
Where are your prices cheapest?
The Wacky Stays website offers the cheapest prices anywhere!
However, if you select us from one of the internet search engines, the price will probably be much higher due to the HUGE commission they add to a booking. The search engines also restrict and control our communications, for their benefit.
Booking with us directly, means you are in-contact with staff living and working on the Wacky Stays site in Kaikoura, NZ. Consequently, we can provide you with local information and more personal service.
We believe this is a fair and honest pricing strategy.
Coffee and Tea provided?
All properties have tea and coffee making facilities, including: Filter coffee, three different teas, drinking chocolate, and real milk.
All properties (except the House Truck) have electronic, barista style, quick-brew, automatic coffee machines, with a hot milk frothing facility.
